name: Arcturus BladeWatch CorpSec Full Field Kit
description:
Head-to-toe CorpSec loadout: matte-black ballistic-rated helmet with integrated AR visor and bone-conduction comms, a modular tactical vest in charcoal over a Pragma compression underlayer, reinforced aug-channel arm sleeves with quick-detach couplings for chrome limbs, slate-grey TacWeave cargo trousers with thigh-mounted mag pouches, and Kessler-grade composite boots with non-slip tread. Velcro ID patches display unit insignia in phosphor yellow.

Vest panels are swappable between hard-plate and flex configurations. Spinal rig channel runs center-back. All seams are aug-split rated for prosthetic limb clearance.
functionality: Integrated AR visor with threat-tagging overlay, aug-split seams at shoulders and hips, spinal rig channel, mag-pouch thigh rails, quick-detach vest panels, sealed boot toe for kick-impact protection.
what_it_says: You are the law inside this corponation's perimeter, and you know it.
story_hooks: A unit patch on the vest belongs to a CorpSec division officially disbanded two years ago — but the officer wearing it is very much active.
The AR visor's threat-tagging database has been quietly updated to flag union organizers as hostiles.
One of the quick-detach vest panels conceals a secondary compartment — someone has been using it to move contraband through checkpoints.

physical_description.visual_profile: Militaristic full-body CorpSec ensemble projecting authority and tactical readiness. Sharp, modular silhouette with pronounced shoulders from vest architecture. Matte-black helmet dominates the upper profile; body reads lean and purposeful beneath layered tactical gear. Phosphor-yellow ID patches provide high-visibility branding against the charcoal and slate palette.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered compression fit through core via Pragma underlayer; tactical vest sits structured and ergonomic over this base. Arm sleeves are snug with reinforced channels accommodating prosthetic quick-disconnects. Cargo trousers offer generous thigh and calf articulation; boots clamp securely without restriction to spinal rig channel.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic-rated synthetic composite (helmet shell), modular tactical weave (vest), Pragma compression synthetics (underlayer), aug-channel reinforced fabric blend (arm sleeves), TacWeave polymer-blend (trousers), Kessler-grade composite (boots)
physical_description.texture: Matte, non-reflective across most surfaces for tactical stealth. Helmet visor area has subtle anti-glare micro-etching. Vest panels show subtle quilting from internal armor integration. Arm sleeves feature raised ribbing along aug-channel zones. Boot treads are aggressively textured for grip; reinforced stitching visible at stress points.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant matte black (helmet, primary vest) and charcoal (secondary panels) with slate grey (trousers). High-contrast phosphor yellow Velcro ID patches at shoulder, chest, and thigh. Minimal accent: steel-tone hardware and magnetic snap fittings.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap fasteners on vest modular panels; friction-fit compression seals on arm sleeves with visible quick-detach couplings. Cargo trousers secure via friction-lock waistband. Boots use integrated lever-lock buckles. Helmet has rear magnetic seal collar.
distinctive_features: Integrated AR visor with bone-conduction comms housing in helmet
Swappable hard-plate and flex-configuration vest panels for mission-specific load
Aug-channel arm sleeves with quick-disconnect coupling ports (chrome limb compatible)
Spinal rig channel running center-back for secondary augmentation or load harness
Thigh-mounted modular mag pouches with retention straps
Phosphor-yellow Velcro ID patches displaying unit insignia
Seams rated for aug-split clearance (prosthetic limb accommodation)
Non-reflective finish throughout for low-profile field operations
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate security apparatus — premium CorpSec-issued loadout. Cost-prohibitive for independent operators; signals direct corpo employment and regulatory authority.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this outfit declares the user as Polaris Navigation Systems security personnel or corporate enforcement. Marks the wearer as armed authority within GLMZ jurisdictions. Associated with corpo infrastructure protection, augmented-personnel oversight, and corporate espionage countermeasures.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically maintained in pristine condition (regular inspections mandatory). Field-worn kits show minor scuff marks on boots and helmet; velcro patches may show slight wear. Rarely patched—damaged components are swapped per corporate SOP rather than repaired in-field.

image_prompt: Cyberpunk CorpSec operative in full tactical kit: matte-black ballistic helmet with glowing AR visor, charcoal modular tactical vest over compression layer, reinforced aug-channel arm sleeves with visible quick-detach couplings, slate-grey TacWeave cargo trousers with yellow phosphor ID patches, Kessler-grade composite boots. Standing rigid in industrial warehouse with cool blue-white neon lighting, cast shadows emphasizing angular tactical silhouette. Polaris Navigation Systems branding subtle on shoulder patch. Dark metallic backdrop, moody urban combat aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
